body:
Spec: docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md (P1 gate evidence: adlc run p1 --ticket <this id> --dir .adlc, manifest segment spec-autopilot-local-01M0Z3K7). The spec is the normative design: sections 2 (loop, recovery, lock), 3 (quota), 4 (selection), 5 (triage), 6 (run), 7 (budgets), 8 (maintenance), 9 (preflight), 10 (observability), 11 (threat model), 12 (failure policy + deadlines), 13 (config), 14 (changes outside the package), 15 (pre-implementation blockers), 16 (70 acceptance criteria). Build EXACTLY what the spec says; where this ticket and the spec disagree, the spec wins and the disagreement is reported. The spec file is deliberately OUTSIDE this ticket's scope: the build must not modify docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md (spec changes go through their own reviewed PR), and the actual-diff check rejects any change to it.

PREREQUISITES (must be merged before this ticket dispatches — enforced by the ticket DAG edge from the fleet-extensions ticket, and by spec section 15): R1 .adlc/config.json landed via the admin trust-root commit; R2 installed adlc plugin == repo version; R3 fleet extensions ticket merged; R4 fleet dry-run green in this repo.

=== TASK ===
Create packages/autopilot (@adlc/autopilot, bin adlc-autopilot, zero third-party runtime deps, @adlc/core + @adlc/fleet + @adlc/tickets only, files under 400 lines, exit codes 0/1/2, --json on every subcommand, --dry-run honest) with subcommands loop | once [--issue N] [--force] [--dry-run] | status | select [--top N] | quota | triage --issue N | reset --issue N --confirm-delete <OID> | init [--labels] [--service] [--write]; the plugin command plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-autopilot.md; docs/systemd/adlc-autopilot.service generator; ADR 0016; registry + docs-site entries so the bijective and dispatcher guards pass.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
AC1. EVERY numbered criterion in docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md section 16 (parsed from the spec at the pinned blob specBlob, never hard-coded) is implemented and green offline. Coverage is NOT a name match: packages/autopilot/test/ac-registry.mjs exports an explicit map from every criterion number to one or more exported test functions; packages/autopilot/test/spec-coverage.test.mjs fails on any criterion missing from the registry, any registered function that is not defined, any registered test that does not import a module from packages/autopilot/lib/ or has no assert call referencing that import, and any numbering that is not contiguous from 1. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/ exit code 0; node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12 exit code 0 with the autopilot package in scope; adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "node --test packages/autopilot/test/" exit code 0.

The following five criteria originate from the spec review and are binding acceptance criteria of this ticket:

AC2 (residual: recovery forgets remote branches after deleting a record). Before any run record is deleted, recovery inspects git ls-remote for the run's branch; if a remote ref exists the record is NOT deleted — the run is retained in its terminal state (or marked orphan when no state applies) until the remote ref is removed under the lease rule. A crash-after-push/no-PR fixture proves the remote ref is found, the record survives, and the next iteration upserts the PR. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/recover.test.mjs (real temporary git repo with a bare origin).

AC3 (residual: local deletion checks are not atomic with destructive commands). Branch deletion uses the conditional form git update-ref -d refs/heads/adlc/autopilot/issue-<n> <expectedOid> (fails if the ref moved) instead of git branch -D; worktree removal first verifies the worktree HEAD equals <expectedOid> and the tree is clean, then removes without --force; any conditional failure preserves all artifacts and marks the run orphan. A fixture advances the branch between the check and the delete and proves nothing is deleted. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/recover.test.mjs.

AC4 (residual: a local git-config marker is treated as proof of branch ownership). reset --issue N --confirm-delete <OID> on a RECORDLESS branch is NON-destructive to the remote even when --delete-remote is passed (that flag is refused with exit 2 for recordless branches): it deletes only local artifacts (worktree, local ref via update-ref -d with the expected OID, marker) and prints the exact git push command the operator may run by hand; the marker alone never authorizes a remote delete. For a RECORD-BEARING run, --delete-remote performs the lease-guarded remote delete of spec section 2.1a Step R. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/recover.test.mjs asserts zero git push argv in that path.

AC5 (residual: shaping-failed has no reset operation). adlc-autopilot reset --issue N --attempts clears the attempt ledger for that issue while preserving the entries in an audit file .adlc/autopilot-runs/<issue>.attempts.archive.json, requires no OID, and is the documented way out of shaping-failed; a reset-after-three-failures fixture proves the issue is selectable again and the archive holds the three entries. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/triage.test.mjs.

AC6 (residual: terminal label and comment effects lack independent reconciliation). Every terminal outcome (blocked, stale, ci-red, oid-mismatch, pr-closed skip) writes a durable intent {commentSentinel, commentPosted, labelApplied} to the run record BEFORE either effect, reconciles each effect independently against GitHub (comment searched by sentinel; label read from the issue/PR) and completes missing effects idempotently on the next iteration before the run is treated as quarantined; a gh fake that fails between comment and label for EACH terminal outcome proves exactly one missing effect is replayed and nothing is duplicated. VERIFY: node --test packages/autopilot/test/terminal-effects.test.mjs table-driven over all five outcomes.

AC7. Root test suite and registry guards green with the new package. VERIFY: npm test exit code 0 (includes apps/docs/test/toolkit-packages.test.mjs bijective + toolkit-usage-dispatcher.test.mjs).
AC8. Preflight gates green before push. VERIFY: npm run preflight exit code 0.
AC9. Rails unchanged: packages/fleet/lib/env-scrub.mjs, packages/fleet/lib/sandbox.mjs and scripts/preflight.mjs (review-runner.mjs and protected-paths.mjs are deliberately NOT railed: the prerequisite fleet ticket edits review-runner.mjs and open issue #632 lives in protected-paths.mjs). VERIFY: adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --ticket <this id> exit code 0.
AC10. Live canary recorded in the PR body: adlc-autopilot once --issue <a documentation-labeled issue> --dry-run exits 0 with zero mutating calls, then the live once produces one PR with green CI and a manifest carrying coldstart, spec-lint and cross-model-review entries bound to the minted ticket. VERIFY: adlc run p5 --ticket <minted id> exit code 0 in the issue worktree (spec AC 17).

=== NOT IN SCOPE ===
Automatic merge (P6 stays human). Remote Control hub (spec section 10.1, follow-up). Other adapters than claude-code. Any change to the fleet flags themselves (prerequisite ticket). .adlc/config.json content (R1, operator).
title: Build @adlc/autopilot: quota-gated local issue-to-PR loop composing fleet (spec issue-autopilot-local)
